statement: The repository owner waives the human review gates listed below as prerequisites for ASH PRIME teacher qualification and training start. A waiver is an owner decision, not a review: no gate listed here has been reviewed, approved, attested or signed by an independent party, and none may be reported as verified, approved or completed.
authority_basis: Owner instruction of 2026-11-24: these gates are not required to begin training.

waived_gates.reason: Owner accepts model-weight and output licence risk without independent legal review.
waived_gates.residual_risk: Training-output rights for some teacher models remain unconfirmed by a lawyer, so redistribution of derived weights may carry unresolved licence risk.

waived_gates.reason: Owner does not require two independent human graders before training; the locked local Qwen3.5-2B grader is the only grading in use.
waived_gates.residual_risk: Teacher response quality is ungraded by humans, so the corpus may include weak responses.

waived_gates.reason: Owner waives a separate independent safety review of teacher outputs before training.
waived_gates.residual_risk: No independent safety pass exists over teacher outputs before distillation.

waived_gates.reason: Owner waives the custody sign-off; leakage auditing stays automated through scripts/validate_ash_prime_holdout.py.
waived_gates.residual_risk: Holdout custody is automated only; no human custody attestation exists.

waived_gates.reason: Owner waives the human corpus attestation; digests and duplicate counts are computed by tooling.
waived_gates.residual_risk: Corpus provenance rests on computed digests, not a signed human attestation.

waived_gates.reason: Owner waives written training-output permission from each teacher rights holder before training begins.
waived_gates.residual_risk: Distilled weights may not have explicit written permission from every teacher rights holder.

reporting_rule: Results that rely on this file must report review_basis=owner_waiver and list the waived gates; they must not claim independent review.
